container.vector.int_push_back.description_en: Cost of std::vector<int>::push_back for int elements, measured over N append operations.
container.vector.int_push_back.description_zh: std::vector<int>::push_back 追加 int 元素的开销，基于 N 次追加操作测量。

container.vector.int_push_back_reserved.description_en: Cost of std::vector<int>::push_back for int elements after reserve(N), measured over N append operations.
container.vector.int_push_back_reserved.description_zh: 在 reserve(N) 之后，std::vector<int>::push_back 追加 int 元素的开销，基于 N 次追加操作测量。

container.vector.int_random_read.description_en: Cost of random indexed read from std::vector<int>, measured over N reads using a shuffled index order.
container.vector.int_random_read.description_zh: std::vector<int> 随机下标读取 int 元素的开销，基于按打乱顺序执行的 N 次读取测量。

container.vector.int_iteration.description_en: Per-element iteration cost for std::vector<int>, measured by traversing all N int elements.
container.vector.int_iteration.description_zh: std::vector<int> 的单元素遍历开销，通过遍历全部 N 个 int 元素测量。
